form:FormGroup.helpText: Uses a local snapshot of the store for reference data lookups in pipelines, instead of asking the node that holds the store. Default is unticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Pipeline lookups read a local copy instead of the store's node.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Uses a local snapshot of the store for the getState() function, instead of asking the node that holds the store. Default is unticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: getState() reads a local copy instead of the store's node.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Uses local snapshots of the store for searches, so a query can run on any node instead of only the node that holds the store. Default is unticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Searches read a local copy instead of the store's node.
